name: The Returning Yesterday
introDiscord:
You arrive at a campsite.

Shizuki's campsite.

Fresh.

Then you blink.

It becomes ancient.

Then fresh again.
introTwitch:
You arrive at a campsite.

Shizuki's campsite.

Fresh.

Then you blink.

It becomes ancient.

Then fresh again.

the-returning-yesterday-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across The Returning Yesterday.

left.message:
A chest alternates between unopened, empty, and already-looted.

You grab it during unopened.

right.message: You rest beside yesterday's version of Shizuki's camp.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Yesterday's Revenant arrives from an event that already happened.

the-returning-yesterday-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Returning Yesterday, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
The Revenant repeats the same entrance.

You remember it this time.

right.message:
One Berry rests beside a note:

'I remember writing this tomorrow.

This sentence made sense when I started it.'

forward.message: A cache contains dust from tomorrow and treasure from yesterday.

the-returning-yesterday-threshold.prompt: Near Chronology Crypt, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A coffer appears before whoever originally hid it.

right.message: A Revenant arrives one day too early.

forward.message: A peaceful version of yesterday restores you.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Chronology Crypt
boss-antechamber.prompt: Chronology Crypt fills with overlapping versions of the same chamber.

bossPromptDiscord:
Chronology Crypt fills with overlapping versions of the same chamber.

A figure walks toward you from tomorrow while casting a shadow into
yesterday.

Use /yes to enter or /no to deal with this at a more
reasonable time.
bossPromptTwitch:
Chronology Crypt fills with overlapping versions of the same chamber.

A figure walks toward you from tomorrow while casting a shadow into
yesterday.

Use !yes to enter or !no to deal with this at a more
reasonable time.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Chronology Crypt. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The timelines overlap.

Tomorrow's Ancestor reveals itself!

completionText:
The chamber returns to the present.

Shizuki's note says:

'FINALLY.'
